definitions.aggregation: Unweighted owner means and defined-value counts only; no ratios, thresholds, gates, bootstrap or efficacy claim.
definitions.frame_minus_bicycle: owner-paired frame minus bicycle for each side and ON-minus-OFF gain
definitions.loggain: ln(ON conditional target probability) - ln(OFF conditional target probability)
definitions.undefined: Zero colour mass makes conditional probability undefined; zero target probability makes its log undefined. Nulls are excluded from means and counted via n; no epsilon floor.

provenance_scope: Local captured JSON digests and receipt consistency only. Source and adapter hashes are recorded identities, not remote or live-weight rehash verification. Primary report preserved.
